segments.he:
תּוֹרָה רכט
יֵשׁ עֵצִים שֶׁכְּשֶׁעוֹשִׂים מֵהֶם מִטָּה, מְסֻגָּלִים לְהוֹלָדַת בָּנִים וּלְגַדְּלָם, וְכֵן לְהִפּוּךְ, יֵשׁ שֶׁאֵינָם מְסֻגָּלִים וְכוּ':
segments.en: There are trees that when a bed is made from them — they have the power of a remedy [segulah] for bearing children and raising them. And likewise the opposite — there are some that are not a remedy etc.
